actualEntry: normal isolated Start/departure/automatic enemy contact/initial custom/PauseButton/KeyboardSettingsButton or GamepadSettingsButton
pointerPath: actual EventSystem Raycast + pointer down/up/click, including4:3 narrow-width targets
keyCapture: virtual Keyboard StateEvent through normal Update; simultaneous J+K rejected, neutral then Space swaps Attack/Card in candidate only
padCapture: virtual Gamepad StateEvent through normal Update; South held swaps Confirm/Decide in candidate only, no implicit apply
requiredClear: custom Confirm clear rejected and original Start retained
discard: Close/reopen restores applied original keyboard profile
saveReload: normal stop/reopen same isolated settings/checkpoint/progress/ContinueCheckpointButton; keyboard Space and pad South loaded as saved
reset: actual confirmation cancel then confirm; candidate defaults not applied until Save; both15/37 original binding maps restored
